title: Couple weeks & leaks!
text: Couple weeks & leaks!. Weighted by “sand like beads” it leaks these & can’t find the hole. The beads are so small it’s almost impossible to find where they’re coming from.

product_metadata.title: Uttermara Sherpa Fleece Weighted Blanket 12 lbs for Adults, Luxury Shaggy Faux Fur & Cozy Fluffy Sherpa Reverse Snugly Heavy Blanket, Twin Size Throw Blanket for Sofa Bed, 48 x 72 inches, Rainbow
features: Dual-Sided, Double the Comfort: Made with 100% polyester microfiber fabric, Uttermara deluxe fluffy weighted blanket combines luxurious softness with ultimate comfort with its 1.57inch 260GSM plush faux fur fleece top and 220GSM Sherpa reverse. The conscientious seams achieve a neat look, enhanced durability and even weight distribution

Choose Your Blanket Wisely: It is recommended to choose a weighted blanket that weighs 10% of your body weight plus 1lb. But for starters, we suggest you to choose a lighter weight. It may take 3 to 5 days to get used to the weight. Weighted blankets with dimensions of 48" x 72" 12 lbs are suitable for 110-140 lbs individual use on single bed

Multiple Uses: Uttermara fluffy faux fur weighted blanket offers you unexpected comfort and warmth and fits effortlessly into your daily life whether you are unwinding at your couch, dozing off in your bed, enjoying movie in home theater or idling in the park

Easy Maintenance: Crafted with premium material, this cozy plush blanket is durable and skin-friendly without any fading or shedding. It is suggested to use commercial washer or spot clean (if weighted blanket over 12 lbs) due to the limited capacity of domestic washing machine

100% Satisfactory Service: We are dedicated to improving your shopping experience. Feel free to contact us for exchange or refund if you are not satisfied with our product. We are always at your service

details.Product Care Instructions: Commercial Machine Wash on Gentle Cycle, Spot Clean Daily
